title: Mask My File
hero: Find private details, pick exactly what to hide, and hand over a verified copy while the context people need stays put.
formatsTitle: The same private workflow for every file
formatsText: Preview images and PDFs at full width, zoom up to 5× and mark exact areas by hand. Search every match in Text, JSON, XML, HTML, CSV, TSV and RTF, then reach for stars, partial masks, placeholders, pseudonyms or removal. Metadata is stripped wherever the format allows.
verifyText: Mask My File writes a fresh copy, reopens it and confirms the protected file is still valid before showing Private Ready. Your original is left completely alone.
batchTitle: Review up to 100 files at once
batchText: Give every file its own preview and manual selections, search the same private text across the whole batch, then export all the verified copies together.
supportTitle: Protect a file in three clear steps
supportIntro: Open Mask My File before sending a rental application, a medical record, a client file, a screenshot or anything carrying details other people do not need to see.
step1: Choose a photo, PDF, document, structured-data file or pasted text. Scanning kicks off locally on your device straight away.
step2: Look over every finding, add anything that was missed or mark an exact area, then choose a protection style the file type supports.
step3: Build the protected copy and share it only after Private Ready confirms the new output reopened and passed its check.
faqText: It means the newly protected copy was rendered, reopened and checked for a valid file structure. It never stands in for your own final look before you share.
contactText: Email hourstag.app@gmail.com with your device model, iOS version, file type and a short note about what you were doing.
privacyIntro: Mask My File is made to protect files without ever collecting them. No account is required, and the app carries no advertising, tracking, analytics or content-upload service.
deviceText: Apple Vision and the embedded Tesseract OCR engine scan the content you pick locally. Masking, redaction, metadata removal, export and verification all run on the device as well.
faceText: Face detection only marks image regions for you to review. Mask My File never identifies people, builds a biometric or identity template, uploads face data, shares it or keeps separate face data.
storeTitle: Purchases are the only network call
storeText: Apple processes the optional lifetime purchase and restore through StoreKit. Mask My File uses no VPN, NetworkExtension, proxy, tunnel, DNS filter or network routing at all.
retentionText: Originals are never overwritten. Temporary workspace files, saved projects, Placeholder Vault mappings and Private Session data stay only as each feature explains. Delete them in the app or remove the app to clear its local container.
